title: Hero story: trace lineage through folded source rows

comments.author: home
comments.text: Fixed in story.ts: the lineage block lights the span on wave or title and adds a span → chop ribbon. ribbon() gains a `far` end opacity (lineage uses 0.7–0.8; the chop → tile alpha goes 0.22 → 0.42). Verified in the browser at the finale: the folded drums strip is lit with a curve to its chop; at bar 5, both the horns chain (wave span → chop 1 → tile) and the drums chain are drawn. Tests 4/4; build OK.
